before_access: This policy is hash-recorded before file descriptor or NWB header requests.
transport: HTTPS streaming Range requests, strict HTTP206, Content-Range bounds; reject HTTP200 without consuming its body
allowed_structure: Root and interval group names, shapes and dtypes only; do not open units, processing, acquisition values
important_boundary: HDF5 structural ranges can contain opaque adjacent bytes. Never claim zero physiological bytes transported; only permitted metadata decoded. Store range hashes/offsets, not opaque payloads.
admission: Even complete stimulus timestamps do not prove raw recording end or absence of unreported gaps. Missing native recording-support evidence remains UNKNOWN. Apply uniform procedure to all session descriptors.
